name: apusr_middle_core_stage1_12_spatial2col
purpose: replacement middle-core design contract for the active spatial-core spine

notes: Use shim/memory-tile tensor address generation to gather C16 halo patches directly from the row-major frame.
Use the GPU-written one-pixel zero guard border for front frame-edge halo values.
Use tensor address generation to gather compact halo patches from the zero-guarded row-major C16 ingress frame.

cell_shapes.name: c16_cell
cell_shapes.description: Owned C16 activation cell; normal ingress, egress, and SkipA unit.

cell_shapes.name: c16_halo_cell
cell_shapes.description: C16 3x3 consumer view: one-pixel spatial border around a 16x8 owned cell.

cell_shapes.name: c16_row_seam
cell_shapes.description: One vertical C16 edge column from a 16x8 owned cell for left/right neighbor seam exchange.

cell_shapes.name: c32_cell
cell_shapes.description: Owned C32 activation cell after the first downsample/encoder transition.

cell_shapes.name: c32_halo_cell
cell_shapes.description: C32 3x3 consumer view for spatial mixing without package-sized halos.

cell_shapes.name: c64_halo_cell
cell_shapes.description: C64 3x3 consumer view; large enough that FIFO depth must stay one.

cell_shapes.name: c8_quadrant_cell
cell_shapes.description: One grouped C8 decoder quadrant emitted by the CT2D/up path.

cell_shapes.name: c8_halo_chunk
cell_shapes.description: One C8 halo chunk consumed by the decoder without NHWC package repack.

halo_policies.name: dma_tensor_halo_patch
halo_policies.description: The front stage consumes dense 18x10xC16 patches gathered by tensor-addressed DMA from the C16 frame. Interior halo pixels come from the frame itself; true frame edges are supplied by the zero-guarded C16 ingress frame path.

halo_policies.name: interior_neighbor_or_true_frame_edge
halo_policies.description: Later C32/C64 spatial windows use local/neighbor consumer views; true frame-edge zeros are a boundary condition only.

halo_policies.name: ct2d_direct_quadrant_halo
halo_policies.description: CT2D emits C8 quadrant halo chunks directly to the decoder path, avoiding a full NHWC package repack.

line_ring_policies.name: c16_front_halo_patch_tap
line_ring_policies.purpose: C16 front spatial windows use tensor-addressed halo patch gathers, not row rings or seam exchange.

line_ring_policies.name: c32_three_line_ring
line_ring_policies.purpose: C32 spatial mix and SkipB delay use row rings.

line_ring_policies.name: c64_depth_one_ring
line_ring_policies.purpose: C64 bottleneck cells stay depth-one unless compile evidence justifies deeper buffering.

row_ring_budgets.capacity_policy: The front worker sees one compact 18x10xC16 patch per output cell. Full shard rows and seam objects are not materialized.

front_c16_row_engine.name: front_c16_halo_patch_engine
front_c16_row_engine.owned_cell_policy: the compute unit remains one 16x8 C16 cell, but the input object is the exact 18x10 C16 consumer view
front_c16_row_engine.frame_edge_policy: true frame edges are supplied by the zero-guarded C16 ingress frame path
front_c16_row_engine.interior_edge_policy: interior halos come from the row-major frame tensor tap; no interior zero-padding and no explicit seam exchange
front_c16_row_engine.host_tap_policy: bounded row-block tensor DMA tasks stream patch-major front inputs from a zero-guarded row-major C16 frame

front_c16_seam_exchange.source: zero-guarded row-major C16 frame tensor tap
front_c16_seam_exchange.destination: dense 18x10xC16 halo patch consumed by the front worker
front_c16_seam_exchange.interior_edge_policy: interior halo pixels are gathered from the source frame; never zero-pad interior edges
front_c16_seam_exchange.frame_edge_policy: zero-guarded C16 ingress frame handles true frame edges

memory_tile_arena_groups.name: macro_lane_memory_tiles
memory_tile_arena_groups.capacity_policy: Aggregate planning may span adjacent memory tiles, but each physical memory tile keeps its own hard 512 KiB budget.

compute_tile_neighbor_groups.name: macro_lane_compute_tiles
compute_tile_neighbor_groups.capacity_policy: Neighbor memory visibility reduces copies and halo traffic; local data and program memory budgets remain per physical compute tile.

memory_tiles.name: mem0
memory_tiles.purpose: Ingress C16 cells and delayed SkipA cells share the column-0 memory tile.

memory_tiles.name: mem1
memory_tiles.purpose: SkipB staging and C16 egress share the column-1 memory tile.

implementation_phases.name: spatial_core_stage1_12_spine
implementation_phases.purpose: Primary spatial-core topology for the Stage1-4 milestone: Stage1 and Stage2 are fused as a paired 36x20 C16 macroblock producer. One shared 34x18 Stage1 patch is reused to produce the four Stage2 C16 cells needed by one Stage3 k2/s2 output cell. Those cells are teed to the long-lived SkipA slice in the combined SkipA/SkipB arena and passed as a compact 2x2 C16 group to split Stage3. Stage4 is split off for the next C32 halo-ring boundary.

implementation_phases.name: front_c16_row_engine
implementation_phases.purpose: Diagnostic row-window front C16 isolation path retained for comparison only. The primary spatial-core now exercises the Stage1-4 carrier; this diagnostic still uses tensor-DMA halo patches instead of row rings or seam exchange.

implementation_phases.name: cell_conveyor_envelope
implementation_phases.purpose: Legacy lane-major C16 cell transport diagnostic retained for build isolation only; not the active spatial-core ABI.

implementation_phases.name: c16_halo_envelope
implementation_phases.purpose: Minimal owned-cell to C16-halo object diagnostic retained for build isolation only.

pipeline_stages.name: front_c16
pipeline_stages.model_role: front C16 halo-patch tensor engine and SkipA producer
pipeline_stages.row_role: C16 front encoder and SkipA producer
pipeline_stages.state_policy: one dense 18x10xC16 halo patch feeds each front cell; no row ring and no seam ObjectFifos

pipeline_stages.name: encoder_c32
pipeline_stages.row_role: C32 encoder, FasterNet32, and SkipB producer
pipeline_stages.state_policy: C32 paired macroblock and local spatial-mix window

pipeline_stages.name: bottleneck_c64
pipeline_stages.model_role: C64 bottleneck and CT2D C8 fanout
pipeline_stages.row_role: C64 bottleneck and CT2D C8 fanout
pipeline_stages.state_policy: C64 cells stay depth-one; CT2D emits grouped C8 chunks

pipeline_stages.name: decoder_c16
pipeline_stages.model_role: C16 decoder, SkipA join, and output pack
pipeline_stages.row_role: decoder, SkipA join, and output pack
pipeline_stages.state_policy: C8 quadrant groups join locally with delayed C16 SkipA cells

object_fifos.name: front_c16_halo_patch
object_fifos.purpose: DMA-gathered 18x10xC16 front patch; left/right/top/bottom halo is part of the tensor access view, not neighbor seam traffic.

object_fifos.name: skipa_c16_delay_cell
object_fifos.purpose: SkipA delay ring; kept in memory-tile arena instead of re-streaming full packages.

object_fifos.name: c32_consumer_halo_view
object_fifos.purpose: C32 spatial-mix window formed at the consumer.

object_fifos.name: skipb_c32_delay_cell
object_fifos.purpose: SkipB delay ring in memory-tile arena.

object_fifos.name: c64_cell
object_fifos.purpose: C64 bottleneck cell. Depth stays one to protect local memory.

object_fifos.name: c64_consumer_halo_view
object_fifos.purpose: C64 window consumed by the up path without package materialization.

object_fifos.name: ct2d_c8_halo_chunk
object_fifos.purpose: C8 decoder quadrant halo handoff; no full NHWC package repack.

object_fifos.name: egress_c16_cell
object_fifos.purpose: Output cells leave the spatial lane through the frame-slot egress ring.

memory_tiles.name: mem0
memory_tiles.arena_policy: Ingress cells and SkipA delay ring share one memory tile in the discipline profile.

memory_tiles.name: mem1
memory_tiles.arena_policy: SkipB delay and egress staging share one memory tile in the discipline profile.
